readme.summary: This is the monorepo root README, not package-specific documentation — it contains no information about @formatjs/intl-pluralrules itself.
readme.top_issue: The README is for the entire FormatJS monorepo and provides zero package-specific content: no description of what intl-pluralrules does, no installation instructions, no usage examples, and no configuration guidance.
